verses.text: One of the seven angels with the bowls came and said to me, “Come, I’ll show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits by many waters.
The kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the people of the earth got drunk on the wine of her immorality.”
Then the angel carried me away in the Spirit to a wilderness. There I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast covered with blasphemous names. It had seven heads and ten horns.
The woman wore purple and scarlet, and was glittering with gold, precious stones, and pearls. She held a gold cup in her hand, full of disgusting things and the impurity of her immorality.
On her forehead was written a mysterious name: “Babylon the Great, the mother of prostitutes and of the earth’s disgusting practices.”
I saw that the woman was drunk with the blood of God’s holy people and the blood of those who testified about Jesus. When I saw her, I was completely amazed.
Then the angel said to me, “Why are you amazed? I’ll explain the mystery of the woman and the beast with seven heads and ten horns that carries her.

The beast you saw once was, now isn’t, and will come up from the Abyss and go to destruction. The people living on earth whose names haven’t been written in the book of life from the creation of the world will be amazed when they see the beast, because it once was, now isn’t, and will come.
This calls for a wise mind. The seven heads are seven hills on which the woman sits.
They’re also seven kings: five have fallen, one is, and the other hasn’t yet come. When he does come, he must remain only a little while.
The beast that once was and now isn’t is an eighth king. He belongs to the seven and is going to destruction.
The ten horns you saw are ten kings who haven’t received a kingdom yet, but for one hour they’ll receive authority as kings along with the beast.
They have one purpose and will give their power and authority to the beast.
They’ll wage war against the Lamb, but the Lamb will defeat them because he’s Lord of lords and King of kings. Those with him are called, chosen, and faithful.”
Then the angel told me, “The waters you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, crowds, nations, and languages.
The beast and the ten horns you saw will hate the prostitute. They’ll strip her and leave her naked, eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.
For God has put it into their hearts to carry out his purpose by agreeing to give their authority to the beast, until God’s words are fulfilled.
The woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth.”
